This Act takes effect June 19, 20 2026. 21 EXPLANATION 22 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 23 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 24 Under current law, the supreme court must establish and 25 may amend a personnel system and a pay and benefits plan for 26 court employees. This bill requires the supreme court to also 27 establish a pay and benefits plan for judicial officers and 28 the state court administrator in addition to court employees. 29 Under current law and the bill, the supreme court is required 30 to set the salary of the state court administrator within 31 pay grade 43 of the pay plans published by the department of 32 administrative services (Code section 8A.461). 33 The bill repeals Code section 602.1501 (judicial salaries) 34 which provides that the general assembly will set the salary 35 -2- LSB 6066XC (4) 91 lh/ns 2/ 3 S.F. _____ for the chief justice of the supreme court, each justice of 1 the supreme court, the chief judge of the court of appeals, 2 each judge of the court of appeals, the chief judge of each 3 judicial district, each district judge, each district associate 4 judge, each full-time associate juvenile judge, each full-time 5 associate probate judge, and each magistrate. Under current 6 law, salary rates for such judicial officers are set by 2025 7 Iowa Acts, chapter 158 (judicial branch appropriations), until 8 otherwise provided by the general assembly. The bill specifies 9 that the bill constitutes subsequent provision of salary rates 10 by the general assembly for purposes of this provision. 11 By operation of law, the bill may affect the salary of a 12 full-time county attorney of a county with a population over 13 200,000, which is required to be between 45 percent and 100 14 percent of a district judge (Code section 331.752(5)). 15 The bill takes effect June 19, 2026. 16 -3- LSB 6066XC (4) 91 lh/ns 3/ 3
